Case note: A.S. No. 1810/2024
Client: Abhishek Gaikwad (truck driver, Kochi)
Opposing party: Swamy Shipping Pvt Ltd
Court: Kerala High Court, before Justice Arvind Bhargava
Filed on: 9 November 2024
Claim amount: Rs 41,13,00,000
Issue: maritime salvage claim. The vessel is about to leave port.
Advice given: Arrest the vessel to secure the salvage claim.
Outcome: The vessel was arrested until security was furnished.
Recommended next step: Negotiate the salvage award.
Matter code: Project Heron
